info.description: SEO & analytics for the public website: Google Analytics and Google Search Console. Changes reach the site within a minute.

googleAnalyticsId.description: Google Analytics 4 Measurement ID, e.g. G-ABC123XYZ (Admin → Data streams → Web). Empty = no Analytics.

analyticsEnabled.description: Quick switch: turn Analytics off without deleting the ID.

requireCookieConsent.description: Ask visitors before loading Analytics (recommended under Thailand's PDPA). Off = load for everyone.

googleSiteVerification.description: Google Search Console → Add property → URL prefix → HTML tag. Paste the whole <meta> tag or just its content value.
